title: Great tour, INCREDIBLE tour guide
text: 10/10 best cocktail class we've ever been a part of. The tour guide, Darragh, brings such an electric personality and life to the tour that makes this an absolute must-do. The drinks were delicious and the setting was nice, but Darragh's enthusiasm and genuine love of his craft made the tour for us.
author: jakepB3680GI

title: You don’t want to miss this class!
text: This was the best cocktail class I’ve ever taken! Darragh is so knowledgeable and gave us the history behind the drinks! The drinks were delicious and the atmosphere was an absolute party vibe!!! He’s great, don’t wait book it today before it sells out!!
author: Kenya_A

text: Me and my partner did this for our birthday. Darragh made this such an amazing experience!! Great drinks, vibe and laughs. 100% recommend this
author: 641finm

title: Great experience
text: Darragh was awesome - such great detail on cocktail technique and absolute lad. They were also able to make gluten free tapas with a bread roll that I brought with me (from a local supermercado) 💕
author: Daydream60878974763

title: Super nice
text: It was super nice, a very cozy place and he is wonderful
author: 509isabellj

title: Must do in Barca
text: I HIGHLY recommend this class. Darragh was knowledgeable and hilarious, my friend and I had an amazing time. The cocktails are all delicious and I can’t wait to make them at home.
author: 32gretchenm

title: Cocktail class
text: Wonderful experience and lovely tasting cocktails and fresh tapas. Highly recommend as a group activity whilst in Barcelona
author: Laura_M

title: Fabulous fun
text:
Had a fabulous time with Darragh our cocktail instructor. Taken to a tiny bar in the Gothic quarter and shown how to make some brilliant cocktails accompanied with tapas. 
Darragh was very knowledgeable and great fun. We were a group of 5 and we loved every minute.
author: sarawendy

title: I would repeat the class again…and again.
text: Fantastic time and the drinks weren’t half bad either, even though we had to make them ourselves. All the drinks were classic recipes so we are set for the next few happy hours. The group we were with was very friendly and social. We would highly recommend this class and hope you are fortunate enough to get Darragh as your host and instructor, now a true friend.
author: Wanderer824196

title: I booked it for a hen...
text: I booked it for a hen party. We were all deathly hung over going to it and to be honest a bit allergic but Nick really brought the vibes and got us right back on track.
author: Dale_O
